rule: Minutes must name dissenters when a motion is not unanimous. Present voting members must vote unless conflicted; a member not indicating a vote is deemed affirmative. Inference requires a source-verified per-vote roster, complete bounded official minutes, resolved dissent and no conflicting tally/exception. CARRIED alone is insufficient.
pre_2021_policy: No default Yes inference until historicalBylaw819 recording convention is verified. Explicit unanimous full ballots can be supported separately when per-vote roster is validated.
limitations: Minutes convention is documentary evidence, not audiovisual confirmation. Nonstandard motions, ambiguous identities/events, missing or partial sources, unresolved opposition and inconsistent membership/tallies are held.
future_policy: Do not infer meetings after enabled_through without refreshing the official bylaw index and checking subsequent amendments or repeal.
